title: Embedded
description: Practices for microcontroller and resource-constrained targets.

practices.title: Minimal ISRs
practices.statement: ISRs set flags or push to queues; they do not compute or allocate.

practices.title: Correct peripheral access
practices.statement: Peripheral accesses are volatile with documented widths and side effects.

practices.title: Check resource budgets
practices.statement: Track flash, RAM, and stack impact of every change against the target's limits.

practices.title: Respect initialization order
practices.statement: Hardware bring-up order follows datasheet requirements; assumptions are checked at startup.

practices.title: Static allocation where required
practices.statement: Use static or stack allocation only in builds where the heap is forbidden.
